WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year,
           1 AS fiscal_week_start,
           22 AS fiscal_week_end
),
net_lines AS (
    -- Sales from stores (excluding web shop and training store)
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, 
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.fiscal_week_start AND params.fiscal_week_end
      AND s.store_id < 900  -- Stores only, excluding web shop (900) and training (999)
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- Returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region,
           -r.refund_net AS net_sales
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.fiscal_week_start AND params.fiscal_week_end
      AND s.store_id < 900
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cs.region,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cs.store_id) AS store_count,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.region = n.region AND cs.is_current
GROUP BY cs.region
ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC;
